welcomeTexts:
Well, well, are you the new arrival? 
A Landlubber, eh?

Looking for reading material for the Library? Well, my friend, 
ready-made books don't just float around in the water here!

Listen here, Landlubber! If you want to see words on a page, 
you'll have to work for it.

Let me show you how we coastal folk make a living. Hop in! 
What are you waiting for? I don't have all day!

gameMonologues.1:
I spotted a membrane drifting quite close. 
Let's go scoop that one up first!
gameMonologues.2:
These are the Membranes. The Letter Sea washed them into the bay.
This is our treasure. And all you have to do is fish them out.
gameMonologues.3:
Nice job! But remember, your Membrane is only safe 
once you bring it back to port! Move it, get back!
gameMonologues.4: WATCH OUT! If you hit a reef, you'll lose your Membranes.
gameMonologues.5:
You need to scoop up thirty of these shiny wonders before the 
Scrollmaster will even bother speaking to you.
gameMonologues.6:
For eleven Pirate Credits, of course.
Nothing is free around here.
gameMonologues.7:
These are just the basic Membranes.
Beyond the bay, out by the reefs, you'll find colored ones too.
Blue, red, green... each a different genre.
gameMonologues.8:
But only old salts like me can make it out there.
And the distant islands... well, never mind. That's not on your level yet.
gameMonologues.9:
Damn it... Sky Pirates! WHAT ARE YOU STARING AT? RUN! 
Back to the port!
gameMonologues.11:
Now, let me explain how life works around here, 
since you seem completely clueless about it.
gameMonologues.12:
Two things matter: Pirate Credits and Talent. You get Credit 
every day you log in. One. But that's just pocket change.
gameMonologues.13:
The Scrollmaster gives you one for thirty Membranes too. 
But that's pennies.
gameMonologues.14:
The real work is at the Tavern. That's where you can get 
quests, once you've earned the right.
gameMonologues.15:
You can read your Scrolls in the Library. 
But you can also sell them for 10 credits, or on the Market.
gameMonologues.16:
Or, you can collect Scrolls until you have all the scrolls for a book.
Then you can have a Copy made from them.
gameMonologues.17:
Once you have a Copy, you can take it to the Shrine and 
consecrate it. That's how you get your hands on a real Book.
gameMonologues.18:
Consecrating a Book requires Talent. 
And you won't fish that out of the water.
gameMonologues.19:
You only get that from Grand Patrons, 
via Patreon or PayPal.
gameMonologues.20:
Or if you find a treasure that another player 
is willing to pay Talent for on the Market.
gameMonologues.21:
There is a Bank, sure, but it only exchanges downwards.
You can sell Talent for Credits, but the other way around... forget it!
gameMonologues.22:
There you go, you're getting the hang of it.
If you keep working this well, maybe one day I'll take you to the Pirate Port, Hebok.
gameMonologues.23:
You can rent or buy a ship there, or even 
join the crew of other ships. Or join the pirates.
gameMonologues.24:
Hebok is also home to the Shrine, 
where Copies are consecrated.
gameMonologues.25:
After consecration, you can download the book,
and you even get ten Copies with it that you can give away as gifts.
gameMonologues.26:
And if you give it to someone who consecrates the Copy they got from you,
you might even line your pockets with some cash.
gameMonologues.27:
Or you can even launch a Book Hunt on it. 
Now, that's where the real fun begins!
gameMonologues.28:
The more books you have, the bigger of a deal 
you become around here. You might even end up as a Captain!
gameMonologues.29:
However, if you steal a book, or let people 
outside the game read it, your punishment will be severe!
gameMonologues.30:
They won't keelhaul you, but your name 
will go up on the wall of shame for everyone to see what you did.
gameMonologues.31:
And even if you had the book consecrated, it will 
lose its value in the game, meaning it goes into Book Prison.
gameMonologues.32:
I'm getting hungry, so you're on your own from here. 
Bring me more Membranes. And watch my ship!
gameMonologues.33:
And if you've written something yourself that you want to bring into the game,
you'll need to go to the monks.
gameMonologues.34:
They live up in the Cloud Monastery, above the Shrine. 
They oversee the written word.
gameMonologues.controls: Use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to steer the ship. You can rotate the camera by holding down either the left or right mouse button. You can advance through / close the information windows by pressing Space.
gameMonologues.wind: Watch the wind direction and trim the sail accordingly!
gameMonologues.airship_bad_empty:
We'd better vanish from their sight right now, 
before they toss us into the sea.

popups.new_membrane:
You've collected another membrane! 
Get back to port!
popups.airship_good: Nice job. Keep up the work!
popups.airship_bad:
They just robbed us. 
Now we have to go back out to fish for more.
popups.beach: Don't run aground on the shore!
popups.out_of_range: We can't head out to the open sea in this wreck.
popups.empty_boat: You returned with an empty boat.
popups.eog_empty_water: The water is suspiciously empty, come on, let's look around the mouth of the bay!
popups.airship_catch:
THEY CAUGHT UP! They're going to question us. Answer right and we get away, 
but make a mistake and they'll take our membranes.
popups.boat_fixing: I patched it up this time, but be more careful!
popups.boat_lowHP:
We won't survive another crash. 
Get the boat back!
popups.airship_bad_empty:
We'd better vanish from their sight right now, 
before they toss us into the sea.

eogMonologues.pointA:
Hey, Landlubber! The water is suspiciously empty...
Let's check out what's happening at the mouth of the bay!
eogMonologues.pointB:
What's that on the shore? That's no membrane, it's... Could it be...? 
That's a CHEST! A CHEST! Quick, we have to grab it!
eogMonologues.chestFound:
I'm taking the boat back to the pier myself now. 
I'm not letting you ruin this for me!
